Prepared for Agri Negosyo Agricultural Supply · system review

How your store is set up

One computer in each store runs everything. Staff and clients open it in a web browser on any device on the store Wi-Fi. Branches keep their own server and database, and the main store watches them from one page.

The screens below use a sample store with made-up products and clients, so you can see how each page works. For each screen, tap Agreed or Needs changes and add a note if you like. When you finish, use Copy my review at the bottom and paste it into our Messenger chat.

Who opens what

Every address also works with the server’s plain network address (for example http://192.168.1.20:8765) on devices that don’t recognise the .local name.

PersonAddressWhat they can do
Owner / Admin…:8765/adminEverything: stock, purchasing, clients, reports, staff, settings, backups and branch monitoring.
Cashier…:8765/cashierPOS and their cash drawer, their own sales history and receipts, client profiles and bulk orders.
Client…:8765/clientPlace bulk orders, follow each order, see their balance, due dates and payments. Nothing else.

How a day runs

Steps where stock or money actually change. Each one is saved completely or not at all.

Selling at the counter

  1. Open cashier sessionCount the opening cash in the drawer.
  2. Search or scan productsA scanned barcode adds one straight to the cart.
  3. Complete the saleStock, earliest-expiring batch, payment and receipt in one step.
  4. Print or show the receipt
  5. Close the sessionCount the drawer; the system shows over or short.

Client bulk order

  1. Client requests an orderFrom the client portal, or staff enters it.
  2. Staff confirmsPrices and availability checked with the client.
  3. Release the goodsStock goes out; unpaid amount becomes the client’s balance. Credit limit is enforced.
  4. Record paymentsStatement of account updates with a running balance.

Restocking

  1. Receive a deliveryStock, batch and expiry, and any payment made.
  2. Check what is owedPurchases and Supplier Payments list each balance.
  3. Pay the supplierCash, transfer or check with check details.
  4. Watch Stock AlertsLow stock and items expiring within 90 days.
